about_the_game:
Despicable Boss takes you on a relentless journey from the lowest depths of hell to its towering heights. In this third-person action game, you play as a cunning demon striving to climb the infernal hierarchy by completing perilous tasks and leveling up.

Each layer brings new, formidable bosses to defeat, pushing you to master combat, strategy, and survival. Navigate treacherous contracts, make morally complex decisions, and manipulate the chaotic structure of hell to rise above. Packed with dark humor, thrilling action, and a deep narrative, Despicable Boss delivers an unforgettable experience.

If you enjoy morally challenging choices, immersive storytelling, and adrenaline-fueled combat, Despicable Boss is the perfect game for you!

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains sexual content such as alchacol use and sexual emblems.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Supports 120 Hz refresh rate
  • Additional Notes: Provides 60 FPS gameplay on low settings
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Supports 120 Hz refresh rate
  • Additional Notes: Provides 120+ FPS gameplay on midle settings
